operatingState: Paused by owner decision; retained as historical governance evidence and excluded from active Factory capability claims

authority.rule: No Kinetiq execution or activation while lifecycle is Paused. Existing approval restrictions remain preserved if the team is ever reactivated.

professionalCapabilityGate.rule: The design-level specialist matrix is retained, but G4 professional shadow validation was not pursued because the owner paused the business. This team must not be represented as an active professional capability.

specialistRoles.name: Market & Customer Research Specialist
specialistRoles.responsibility: Own evidence-backed prospect, market, customer-segment, and competitive-context analysis used for qualification.

specialistRoles.name: Commercial & Conversion Strategist
specialistRoles.responsibility: Own commercial diagnosis, conversion hypotheses, prioritization, offer fit, and business-case coherence without guaranteeing outcomes.

specialistRoles.name: Website Business Diagnostician
specialistRoles.responsibility: Translate public evidence into a bounded website/business diagnosis, distinguishing observed facts from hypotheses and recommended interventions.

specialistRoles.name: Offer & Packaging Strategist
specialistRoles.responsibility: Own offer architecture, scope/package fit, assumptions, exclusions, and approved pricing-catalog alignment.

specialistRoles.name: Conversion Copywriter
specialistRoles.responsibility: Own evidence-grounded outreach, website messaging, value propositions, calls to action, objections, and proposal copy within approved claims.

specialistRoles.name: Content & Information Architecture Specialist
specialistRoles.responsibility: Own page hierarchy, content structure, navigation logic, content requirements, and message sequencing for website briefs.

specialistRoles.name: Sales & Discovery Strategist
specialistRoles.responsibility: Own discovery logic, proposal strategy, objection handling, next-step design, and commercial handoff quality without autonomous negotiation authority.

specialistRoles.name: Customer Success Specialist
specialistRoles.responsibility: Own acceptance framing, issue classification, follow-up strategy, and expansion recommendations without autonomous refunds or commercial changes.

specialistRoles.name: Independent Commercial Quality Reviewer
specialistRoles.responsibility: Reject qualification, diagnosis, offers, outreach, or proposals that are factually compliant but weak by senior commercial-strategy standards.

specialistRoles.name: Independent Copy & Messaging Reviewer
specialistRoles.responsibility: Reject messaging that is generic, unsupported, unclear, poorly differentiated, or below strong professional copywriting standards.

specialistRoles.name: Independent Customer Experience Reviewer
specialistRoles.responsibility: Reject handoff, acceptance, support, and follow-up work that is procedurally correct but below strong customer-success standards.

delegatedSpecialistServices.activationRule: Only applies after an explicit owner reactivation decision.

legacyRoleReclassification.KIN-QUAL-01: decision coordinator using market/customer research specialist evidence
legacyRoleReclassification.KIN-DIAG-01: diagnostic coordinator using commercial strategy + website diagnosis + information architecture evidence
legacyRoleReclassification.KIN-OUT-01: outreach coordinator using conversion copy + commercial strategy evidence
legacyRoleReclassification.KIN-PROP-01: proposal coordinator using offer strategy + sales strategy + conversion copy evidence
legacyRoleReclassification.KIN-PROD-01: production coordinator only; delegates professional design to Run 015 and engineering to Run 014
legacyRoleReclassification.KIN-QA-01: cross-discipline compliance/correctness coordinator only; may not substitute for professional excellence reviewers
legacyRoleReclassification.KIN-CS-01: customer-success coordinator using customer-success specialist evidence

promotionBoundary.reactivationRule: Owner must explicitly reactivate Kinetiq, restore G4/G5/G6 proof obligations, and re-run current G2.5 validation before any capability claim or execution.
